title: When the customer pays for itself the Authorizer list is one line per contact
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, with two contacts, contact A1 and contact A2, that can be picked as Authorizer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Authorizer field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list shows "No authorizer", then contact A1 and contact A2.
  • Each contact shows on one line, with no customer name under it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12306 (Story 4, Authorizer list when someone else pays)

  • S4-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, the list is exactly today's, with no second line.”
